triples.head_surface: Check the temperature before opening any covers, plates, or plugs.
triples.head_canonical_zh: 检查温度后再打开任何盖板、板或插头
triples.tail_surface: opening any covers, plates, or plugs.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 打开任何盖板、板或插头
triples.evidence_text: Check the temperature before opening any covers, plates, or plugs.

triples.head_surface: Close the suction and discharge valves.
triples.tail_surface: closing the suction and discharge valves.
triples.evidence_text: Close the suction and discharge valves.

triples.head_surface: Vent the pump slowly and cautiously.
triples.tail_surface: venting the pump slowly and cautiously.
triples.evidence_text: Vent the pump slowly and cautiously.

triples.head_surface: Do not operate the pump against a closed discharge valve for long periods of time.
triples.head_canonical_zh: 不要长时间让泵在关闭排出阀的情况下运行
triples.tail_surface: pump components will deteriorate, and the liquid could come out of the pump.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵组件会损坏，液体可能会从泵中流出
triples.evidence_text: Do not operate the pump against a closed discharge valve for long periods of time. If operated against a closed discharge valve, pump components will deteriorate, and the liquid could come out of the pump.

triples.head_surface: Suction and discharge hoses and piping must be removed from the pump before lifting.
triples.head_canonical_zh: 提升前必须将吸入和排出软管及管道从泵上移除
